vintage: 2025 World Bank WDI, National Stats & NASA MODIS

lenses.name: Population
lenses.description: Residents per km² by province/oblast/viloyat (2025). Highlights the dense Fergana Valley, Tashkent & Almaty oases vs the Kazakh Steppe. Colour range spans the 2nd–98th percentile of hexes.

lenses.name: Pop. growth
lenses.description: Population change 2021–2025 by region. Astana, Almaty, Tashkent and southern Central Asia are among Eurasia's fastest-growing regions. Colour range spans the 2nd–98th percentile of hexes.

lenses.name: Median age
lenses.description: Median age of residents by region. Tajikistan and southern Uzbekistan average 22–27 years vs 36–39 in northern Kazakhstan. Colour range spans the 2nd–98th percentile of hexes.

lenses.name: Income
lenses.description: Estimated median annual household income by region (USD). Oil-rich Atyrau, Astana, Almaty, Tashkent and Navoiy lead. Colour range spans the 2nd–98th percentile of hexes.

lenses.name: GDP / person
lenses.description: Gross Regional Product per resident (2025 USD), calibrated to World Bank national GDP. Colour range spans the 2nd–98th percentile of hexes.

lenses.name: Poverty
lenses.description: Share of population below national poverty lines by region. Colour range spans the 2nd–98th percentile of hexes.
lenses.note: National poverty lines differ between republics; compare trends rather than exact cutoffs.

lenses.name: Homeowners
lenses.description: Share of households owning their home (post-1991 privatization keeps ownership above 85% in most provinces, lower in booming capitals). Colour range spans the 2nd–98th percentile of hexes.

lenses.name: Degrees
lenses.description: Share of adults 25+ holding university or higher technical degrees. Astana, Almaty, Bishkek and Tashkent lead. Colour range spans the 2nd–98th percentile of hexes.

lenses.name: Internet
lenses.description: Share of residents using internet & broadband (ITU / World Bank 2024). Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan & Uzbekistan exceed 89%. Colour range spans the 2nd–98th percentile of hexes.

lenses.name: Commute
lenses.description: Estimated average one-way commute time by region (longest in metro Almaty, Tashkent, Astana & Bishkek). Colour range spans the 2nd–98th percentile of hexes.

lenses.name: Faith
lenses.description: Estimated religiously affiliated residents per 100 people by region (Pew Research & national census estimates).
lenses.note: Combines census self-identification (KZ, KG) and survey estimates (UZ, TJ, TM); secular urban share is higher in northern Kazakhstan.

lenses.name: Largest tradition
lenses.description: Largest religious tradition by province: Hanafi Sunni Islam across most of Central Asia, Ismaili Shia in the Pamirs (GBAO), and Orthodox pluralities in northern Kazakhstan.
lenses.note: Shows the largest single tradition in each province, not homogeneity.

categories.name: Sunni Islam
categories.description: Hanafi Sunni Muslim plurality/majority across Uzbekistan, Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan, Tajikistan & Turkmenistan.

categories.name: Ismaili Shia Islam
categories.description: Nizari Ismaili Shia majority in Gorno-Badakhshan (Pamir Mountains, Tajikistan).

categories.name: Orthodox Christian
categories.description: Russian Orthodox historical plurality in northern Kazakhstan border regions.

lenses.name: Natural hazards
lenses.description: Major recorded natural disasters (earthquakes, glacial mudflows, snowmelt floods, droughts & severe freezes, 1980–2025). Highest along the Pamir–Tian Shan seismic arc and northern Kazakh floodplains.
lenses.note: Counts recorded major hazard events touching each region (EM-DAT / UNDRR), not total economic loss.

lenses.name: Forest
lenses.description: Share of each hex covered by Altai, Tian Shan spruce, northern pine/birch, walnut or tugay forests (NASA MODIS IGBP 2022).

lenses.name: Farmland & oases
lenses.description: Share of each hex in cropland: northern Kazakhstan's steppe wheat belt and the irrigated river oases of Fergana, Zarafshan, Khorezm & Murgab (NASA MODIS 2022).

lenses.name: Built-up
lenses.description: Share of each hex classified as urban and built-up (NASA MODIS IGBP 2022).
